# scamp_router (Data Source)

Retrieves information about an existing router by UUID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The UUID of the router to retrieve.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the router was created.
- `ipv4_address` (String) Public IPv4 address of the router.
- `ipv6_address` (String) Public IPv6 address of the router.
- `name` (String) Name of the router.
- `status` (String) Current status of the router.
